cards.text: Judah's in trouble, friend. In the third year of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, comes to Jerusalem and besieges it. That is NOT company dropping by.

cards.question: Nebuchadnezzar has Jerusalem under siege. Who delivers Jehoiakim, king of Judah, into his hand?

cards.text: Some of the articles from the house of God get carried off to the land of Shinar, to the house of Nebuchadnezzar's god. Getting carried off and tucked away is my whole life story, friend, just ask my old junk drawer.

cards.question: Nebuchadnezzar brings the articles from the house of God to the house of his god, and he puts them in the ___ of his god.

cards.text: Then the king orders Ashpenaz, the chief of his court officials, to bring in young Israelites from the royal family and the nobility: without blemish, handsome, gifted in all wisdom and quick to understand. With my blurry old edges, I wouldn't have made it past the front door.

cards.question: Nebuchadnezzar wants the sharpest young men from Judah's royal family and nobility. What is he picking them for?

answers.text: To serve in the king's palace
To lead the army of Babylon
To guard the treasury of his god

cards.question: These young Israelites are going to serve a foreign king. So before they serve, Ashpenaz is to teach them the ___ and literature of the Chaldeans.

cards.text: The king even assigns them daily provisions of the royal food and wine. Friend, he's not just hiring them, he's feeding them on his own tab.

cards.question: The young men picked by the king are trained for three years before they enter his service.

cards.text: Among these young men are four from Judah: Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah. Picture your first day at a new job, friend, except the new job is in BABYLON.

cards.question: Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah are learning Babylon's language to serve Babylon's king. What does the chief official give the four of them?

cards.text: To Daniel he gives the name Belteshazzar, and Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah become Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego. Friend, I had to ask an ANGEL to keep my name, and these guys get new ones handed out like name tags.
But Daniel makes up his mind that he will not defile himself with the king's food or wine. Friend, that's like telling your boss you're passing on his famous homemade cookies, in his own office.

cards.question: Daniel won't defile himself with the king's food or wine, so he takes his request straight to King Nebuchadnezzar.

cards.text: Now God had granted Daniel favor and compassion from the chief official. Favor from God, friend, so this should be easy. SHOULD be.

cards.question: The chief official tells Daniel he fears the king. What is he worried the king will see?

answers.text: Their names left off the list

cards.question: The chief official tells Daniel that skipping the king's food could endanger the chief official's own head before the king.

cards.text: Daniel turns to the steward the chief official put over him, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah. He asks, 'Please test your servants for ten days.'

cards.question: Daniel asks the steward for a ten-day test. What does he ask the steward to give the four of them?
When the ten-day test is over, Daniel tells the steward to ___ their appearances with those of the young men eating the royal food.

cards.text: So the steward consents and tests them for ten days. Friend, I start sweating when my oven timer has thirty seconds left, and these guys are waiting TEN DAYS.

cards.question: At the end of the ten days, the four young men look thinner than the young men eating the king's food.

cards.text: They look healthier and better nourished than ALL the young men eating the king's food. Vegetables and water just walked into the palace and took the title.

cards.question: The test is over, and Daniel and his three friends look healthier than the young men eating the king's food. So what does the steward do from then on?

answers.text: He keeps giving them vegetables instead
He puts them back on the royal food
He asks the king for ten more days

cards.text: And to these four young men God gives knowledge and understanding in every kind of literature and wisdom. That's not hustle, friend, that's a gift from God.

cards.question: On top of all that knowledge and understanding, Daniel has insight into something more. What is it?

answers.text: All kinds of visions and dreams
All the stars in the sky

cards.text: At the end of the time the king specified, the chief official presents them to Nebuchadnezzar. Performance review, friend, and the KING himself is running it.

cards.question: When Nebuchadnezzar speaks with all the young men, he finds no one equal to Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah.

cards.text: So the four of them enter the king's service. Whenever the king consults them about wisdom and understanding, he stacks them up against all the magicians and enchanters in his entire kingdom.

cards.question: In every matter of wisdom and understanding, the king finds Daniel and his three friends ___ times better than all the magicians and enchanters in his kingdom.

cards.text: And Daniel remained there until the first year of Cyrus, king of Persia. From one request about the king's food all the way to a whole new king, friend, now THAT'S staying power.

findings.problem: The setup does not establish that the articles were valuable or would be stored away, so the baker cannot reason out 'treasury' rather than 'altar' or 'courtyard.' This blank asks for unseen verse wording rather than a meaning supported by the earlier cards.

rule.text: The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

findings.problem: Nothing in the earlier cards gives a clue to the multiplier. The baker can only guess among 'ten,' 'two' and 'seven,' so this blank tests an unseen number rather than a meaning the baker can reason out.

rule.text: The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
